content.text: {"core": "Breakthrough removes a structure that no longer holds. Creation is the doorway where finished things pass out into the world. Working there unnoticed, the breaking never gets counted as part of what ships — so the clearing happens, the opening is real, yet nothing downstream registers that anything moved. The exit works and no one marks the passage.", "sheetLine": "The wall came down at the doorway; nobody logged that it fell."}
